semiconductor_relevance: High — Nishida provides specialized equipment for semiconductor assembly, inspection, and measurement, which are critical processes in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Nishida is a key player in the semiconductor equipment sector, focusing on assembly, inspection, and measurement solutions. Their product offerings include automatic positioning and autofocus devices, as well as advanced metrology tools for wafers and substrates, enhancing precision in semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Advanced metrology solutions for wafers and substrates
